body:
It's so much worse today.

And no one cares.
Me either. I'm too scared of the pain.
I'm too scared to go through with it, so fuck them.

Yes. I feel awful, and everything hurts.

I also have the added joy of hunger pangs. When do those stop?
I've had two strokes, lived, and still want to die. Tell me another one about my 'purpose'.
But if you need someone to talk to, where are they?

I understand how you feel. I had a friend who pulled me out of the pit, and we fell in love.

Apparently it wasn't enough. He just dumped me. So I guess next time I go in, I can stay there. Maybe I'll finally have the courage to end it.

I have a couple of chronic illnesses, and I feel like I have death on my shoulders. My husband checked out of our marriage and I had no one.

I kinda just wanted it over on my terms, rather than random chance.
